clue.text: Accident results when trailing part of dress is backed with strong coarse linen

indicators.note: the first piece is followed, at its back, by the second

parts.note: a train is the long part of a gown that trails along the floor behind
crash is a coarse linen fabric used for towels and upholstery

explanation.surface: A dressmaker's account of how a trailing hem ended up lined with sturdy linen.
explanation.definitionFit: A collision of a railway service is a classic serious accident.

clue.text: Commonly the very 'best of spinners?

definitions.meaning: colloquially, something outstanding is said to be 'the ...'
toys that are set whirling on a point are spinning ...

explanation.surface: A question about which spinning bowler is the finest of all.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal speech calls the finest thing 'the tops', and the whirling toys share the plural word.

clue.text: Prepares a sober man against keen resentments

indicators.note: here means placed next to, so the pieces stand side by side

parts.note: TT, teetotal, describes a man who abstains from alcohol
ires are angers or strong resentments

explanation.surface: A teetotaller nursing grudges is up against bitter feelings.
explanation.definitionFit: To dress someone is to get them ready, so clothing a person prepares them.

clue.text: Snaring goes on, but is the basis of a peaceful policy

definitions.text: the basis of a peaceful policy

indicators.note: the phrase says the letters of the preceding words are, in truth, something else once rearranged

explanation.surface: Trapping animals continues, yet a peace-loving policy rests on it.
explanation.walkthrough: The old clue has no firm anagram signal; 'but is' suggests the letters of SNARING GOES ON turn into something else when rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A pact not to attack one another is the foundation of a peaceable foreign policy.

clue.text: Destroying the argument for — ordering a gun refit

indicators.note: ordering means putting the letters of the words into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A debater is ordering a weapon to be overhauled while dismissing a case.
explanation.definitionFit: Disproving a case demolishes the reasoning behind it.

clue.text: Excessive soaking process

definitions.meaning: a ... price is an unreasonably high one
to soak something in liquid, as tea or laundry

explanation.surface: Complaining that a long soak in the wash is too much.
explanation.definitionFit: An exorbitant charge is called steep, and a long immersion in liquid is also a steep.

clue.text: American complaint concerning cattle?

definitions.meaning: in American slang a ... is a grievance
the meat of cattle, so it relates to cows

explanation.surface: An American rancher grumbling about the herd.
explanation.definitionFit: US slang uses the word for a grumble, and it is also the meat of bullocks and cows.

clue.text: Proceed from some source to give a new name to blended tea

indicators.note: a new version of the word is one with its letters rearranged
blended means the letters of the word are mixed into a different order

explanation.surface: A tea merchant renames a house blend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' turns NAME into EMAN and 'blended' turns TEA into ATE.
explanation.definitionFit: To issue or flow out of an origin is to come forth from it.

clue.text: and produce a new liquid, inthe Isle of Wight

parts.note: fresh means newly made or new
water is the commonest liquid

explanation.surface: Making a novel liquid on an English holiday island.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue as held seems to begin mid-sentence; the wordplay and definition are complete. The ISLE OF WIGHT is an island off England's south coast.
explanation.definitionFit: Freshwater is a village at the western end of that island, so it is a place found there.

clue.text: Don set to work

definitions.meaning: to don clothes is to dress in them
to stage or assign, as a play or extra staff, is to arrange it for working

explanation.surface: A university lecturer is told to get busy.
explanation.definitionFit: Dressing in a garment is donning it, and laying on a show or staff sets it going.

clue.text: Bird used as food for a picnic?

definitions.meaning: a thrush that winters in Britain
fare eaten out in a field, the meal of an outdoor picnic

explanation.surface: Wondering whether a bird can be served as an outdoor meal.
explanation.definitionFit: The bird is a large migrant thrush, and the word split is meals eaten in a meadow.

clue.text: Straightforward present — yet what a shocking thing it is!

definitions.text: what a shocking thing it is

parts.note: direct means plain and straightforward
current means present or of now

explanation.surface: Someone receives a plain gift and is shocked by it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'present' looks like a gift but means existing now; 'shocking' is literal, an electric shock.
explanation.definitionFit: A steady one-way electric flow can give an electric jolt.

clue.text: Working up to the matter in hand correctly enables the Tories to gain ground

definitions.text: Working up to the matter in hand correctly

parts.note: the political right means the Conservatives, nicknamed Tories
to approach is to come nearer, gaining ground on something

explanation.surface: A political commentator claims the Conservatives are closing in on power.
explanation.walkthrough: The TORIES are Britain's Conservative Party.
explanation.definitionFit: Tackling an issue the proper way is going about it correctly.

clue.text: Describing the touching of caps of a lower order?

definitions.text: Describing the touching of caps of a lower order?

parts.words: Describing the touching of caps of a lower order?
parts.note: reads like servants touching their caps to betters, but the caps are kneecaps that bump together

explanation.walkthrough: The 'caps of a lower order' are the kneecaps, low on the body, rather than the caps of humble folk.
explanation.definitionFit: Legs that curve inward so the joints touch are described with this term.

clue.text: The animal controller is no singer — that becomes obvious!

indicators.note: the letters of the words become a different word once rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone at a zoo show admits they can't sing, and it shows.
explanation.definitionFit: A loop through a bull's nostrils lets a handler lead it.

clue.text: Plan for a large number to move up to the border in South Africa

indicators.note: the following pieces sit within the letters of the country's abbreviation
the number comes right up beside the next piece

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
a hem is the border of a cloth or garment

explanation.surface: A scheme to push many troops up to a frontier in South Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: An outline or diagram of how something is organised is a plan.

clue.text: Shakespearean who gets to do well with love

parts.note: to prosper is to thrive or do well
love is zero in tennis, written as the letter O

explanation.surface: Asking which Shakespeare figure succeeds through love.
explanation.definitionFit: The magician in The Tempest is one of Shakespeare's characters.

clue.text: Small firm longing described as a milk-production unit!.

parts.note: Co, shortened, is the abbreviation for company
a wish is a longing or desire

explanation.surface: A small dairy business dreams of being a milking operation.
explanation.definitionFit: Resembling the animal that produces milk on a farm.

clue.text: Married, took in hired servant, and ultimately had children

indicators.note: the first piece takes the second inside it, like a household taking in a lodger

parts.note: wed means married
help is a domestic servant employed for wages

explanation.surface: A couple married, hired a maid, and eventually started a family.
explanation.walkthrough: 'had children' is a playful stretch: whelping is properly what dogs do when giving birth.
explanation.definitionFit: Giving birth to puppies or cubs is producing young, used here of offspring generally.

clue.text: City clear perhaps-without single vehicle there!

indicators.note: perhaps hints that the words are a version of something else, rearranged

parts.note: a single one is a, the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A city cleared of traffic leaves room for a lone vehicle.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of CITY CLEAR hold the answer plus A ('single'); 'without' asks for that A to be taken away before 'perhaps' rearranges the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A three-wheeled cycle is a small vehicle.

clue.text: Burn me up in a box

indicators.note: the turned piece goes inside the box word

parts.note: a crate is a box for packing

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word reads from bottom to top

explanation.surface: Someone asks to be burnt in a coffin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reverses ME to EM, which goes into CRATE.
explanation.definitionFit: To reduce a body to ashes is to burn it.

clue.text: What to do with rare wild animals to make provision for the future?

definitions.text: What to do with rare wild animals
definitions.meaning: endangered creatures are kept in a nature or game park
to hold something back for later use

explanation.surface: Wondering what conservationists should do with endangered beasts.
explanation.definitionFit: Animals are housed in a wildlife park, and stockpiling saves something for later.

clue.text: They make tracks for birds

definitions.meaning: the metal bars laid as a railway line form the track
marsh birds such as the water rail

explanation.surface: Birds leaving footprints as they go.
explanation.definitionFit: Steel bars form a railway line, and the rail family includes coots and crakes.

clue.text: Sulphur frequently is malleable

parts.note: S is the chemical symbol for sulphur
oft is an old word for often

explanation.surface: A chemist notes that sulphur is often pliable.
explanation.definitionFit: Easily pressed into shape means yielding, not hard.

clue.text: Not thoughtful now, dear

parts.note: with 'now' it says formerly but not now, which ex- expresses
pensive means thoughtful

explanation.surface: Telling a loved one they have stopped being considerate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not ... now' together mean 'formerly', the prefix EX; 'dear' is not an endearment but costly.
explanation.definitionFit: A costly thing is said to be dear.

clue.text: Muse in the corner at odd moments

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A thinker broods in a corner now and then.
explanation.walkthrough: The run is in 'cornER AT Odd'. 'Muse' looks like a verb, to ponder, but names one of the nine Muses.
explanation.definitionFit: She is the Greek goddess who inspires love poetry, one of the nine.

clue.text: Double celebration that's now extinct

indicators.note: double says the piece appears twice in a row

parts.note: a do is a party or celebration

explanation.surface: A two-fold party for something that has died out.
explanation.definitionFit: The flightless bird of Mauritius died out in the 1600s.

clue.text: Roams aimlessly among the scattered tents — a considerable variety of them

indicators.note: scattered means the letters are strewn into a new order
roaming without aim jumbles the order of the word's letters

explanation.surface: Someone wanders among tents spread over a field of many kinds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'aimlessly' and 'scattered' both signal rearranging: the letters of ROAMS and TENTS together make the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A mixed collection of many kinds is a wide variety.
